newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer launches new silicon production plant.
newsitem.headline: Bayer launches new silicon production plant.

text.p: German chemical giant Bayer AG said on Monday that it officially opened its new solar silicon production facility of Bayer Solar GmbH at Freiberg.
Bayer said it had invested around 48 million marks in the facility which would give it an annual capacity of six million crystalline silicon wafers for making solar modules.
Management board chairman Manfred Schneider said at the launch that the group already planned to expand capacities even further to reach production capacity of 16 million silicon wafers.
